claims.quote: The red-tailed rasbora, Rasbora borapetensis, is a small cyprinid from the Mekong and Chao Phraya drainages and the Mae Klong in western Thailand.
Occurs in the great Mekong and Chao Phraya river drainages as well as the Mae Klong in western Thailand.
It thus has an enormous natural range and has also been recorded from Cambodia, Laos, Vietnam, Peninsular Malaysia and China.
